replicated_originals.reference: Striegel-Moore RH, Wilson GT, DeBar L, et al. (2010) Cognitive behavioral guided self-help for the treatment of recurrent binge eating

A.reason: Ref 23 is the authors' earlier CBT-GSH vs usual-care trial; the paper calls itself 'a replication and extension trial' and concludes it 'replicated and extended the findings from our earlier study (23)', comparing abstinence rates and effect sizes.

B.reason: Ref 1 (NCS-R eating-disorder prevalence) is cited only as background for the >5% prevalence figure and the target age group; 'Replication' in its title refers to the survey name, not a replicated finding.

notes: Self-replication (same group, same HMO setting, modified recruitment/assessment). Ref 39 (Lynch et al. 2010, cost-effectiveness companion paper) is cited alongside 23 for the original trial's cost-effectiveness, but this replication did not re-test cost-effectiveness; its outcomes (binge abstinence, EDE-Q subscales) replicate ref 23.
